name: Better Human Priority Plan
description: Move summary-mode human priority before unassessed-pair window slicing so answered-summary articles are selected first while preserving prompt-mode behavior, safe cursor progression, and existing SQLite ready ordering.

userStories.title: Introduce a dedicated unassessed-pairs cursor contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want queue scanning to use its own priority-aware cursor type so summary-first ordering can evolve without coupling unrelated review-page pagination behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce `UnassessedPairsCursor` in `src/services/olap/olapTypes.ts` with `lastDate`, `lastArticleId`, and `priorityBucket` fields for queue scanning.
Update the unassessed-pair OLAP types and callers to use `UnassessedPairsCursor` instead of the generic `PaginationCursor` used by review-page flows.
Add shared helper logic in `src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.ts` that applies consistent `(priorityBucket DESC, activity DESC, article_id DESC)` ordering and matching cursor comparisons.
Missing or legacy cursor priority values are treated as `0` so pre-existing scan state can continue safely.
Review-page pagination continues to use its existing cursor contract unchanged.
`bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Persist the priority-aware cursor in local job scan state
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want judgment-job SQLite scan state to store the priority bucket so in-progress jobs resume safely after restart without skipping or duplicating articles.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend the judgment-job cursor types and `job_scan_state` persistence in `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentJobSqliteService.ts` to store `priorityBucket` alongside `lastDate` and `lastArticleId`.
Existing local job SQLite files upgrade in place with a safe default of `0` for missing stored priority buckets.
Reading legacy scan state, writing new scan state, and clearing scan state preserve restart safety and do not disturb existing queued rows.
The add-to-queue flow can round-trip the new cursor field between SQLite scan state and OLAP unassessed-pair requests.
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentJobSqliteService.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Make the serving-path candidate window summary-first
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the serving-backed unassessed-pair path to rank answered-summary articles before prompt-row slicing so promoted articles actually enter the returned queue window.
acceptanceCriteria: `getUnassessedCandidateRowsFromServing` derives a `priorityBucket` from the existing `mart.review_article_serving` human-summary signal for summary-mode projects and uses `0` for prompt-mode projects.
The serving-path query orders incomplete LLM candidates by `priorityBucket DESC`, then the existing activity ordering, then `article_id DESC`.

`getUnassessedPairsFromDuckdb` keeps the current `candidateArticles -> promptEntries -> slice(numberOfPromptsToGet)` shape but returns summary-backed articles ahead of non-summary articles in summary mode.
Prompt ordering within a selected article stays unchanged.
The next unassessed-pair cursor includes the `priorityBucket` of the last article that contributed prompt rows to the returned window.
`bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Apply the same priority contract to raw fallback
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the raw unassessed-pair fallback to use the same summary-first ordering and cursor semantics so serving and fallback paths behave consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: The raw fallback derives `priorityBucket` from non-empty `app.judgment_human_summary` rows for the current project using `NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(answer, '')), '') IS NOT NULL`.
Blank, `NULL`, and cross-project summary rows do not promote articles in raw fallback.
The raw fallback uses the same priority-aware ordering and next-cursor semantics as the serving path.
Summary-mode promotion remains article-level only and does not change prompt ordering inside a selected article.
Serving and raw fallback continue to agree on returned prompt order for equivalent inputs.
`bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Lock the behavior with no-skip and edge-case regressions
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want regression coverage for summary-first window selection so future changes cannot reintroduce prompt-slice misses, cursor skips, or mode-specific parity bugs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add serving-path coverage proving a later summary-backed article enters the returned prompt window ahead of a fresher non-summary article when prompt-row slicing would previously have excluded it.
Add cursor coverage proving a summary-first first window does not cause displaced non-summary articles to be skipped on the next call.
Add raw fallback coverage proving summary-first ordering matches the serving path for equivalent inputs.
Add edge-case coverage proving prompt mode stays unchanged and that blank, `NULL`, and cross-project summary rows do not affect priority.
Existing `judgmentsJobsAddToQueue` summary-priority tests continue to pass so add-to-queue remains the secondary guard after pre-slice selection.
`bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes
